req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-037 requires that POST /tasks/ trims leading and trailing whitespace from the task title before persisting it. The test suite must verify: (1) positive — a title with surrounding whitespace is stored trimmed; (2) negative — a title that is only whitespace becomes empty after trimming and should be rejected (min_length=1 enforced by schema); (3) boundary — a title with exactly one non-whitespace character surrounded by whitespace trims to length 1 (the minimum valid length). Additional cases cover leading-only, trailing-only, and internal whitespace (internal spaces must NOT be trimmed). Each test asserts the exact response status code and the exact 'title' field value in the JSON body to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed
actions: POST /tasks/ with title '   Buy milk   ' (leading and trailing spaces)
trace: R-TASK-037: system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from title
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import json

def test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "   Buy milk   ", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"
    assert body["title"] != "   Buy milk   "

test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed()
